description: Agent Energy: submit a solar or PPA proposal’s claims and the assumptions it states: optionally the proposal with its id, installer, kind (a purchase, a loan, a lease or a power purchase agreement) and its sales wording, read for promises such as guaranteed savings or free solar; the system with its size in kW, its claimed first-year production and location; the assumptions with yearly usage, the utility rate, the export credit, the yearly rate rise, yearly degradation, the years counted, the PPA price and its escalator, the lease payment, the system cost, the currency and each incentive with its id, name, kind, amount and whether eligibility was confirmed; the claims of first-year savings, lifetime savings, payback in years and the share of usage covered; and optionally the highest credible yield per kW (1,900 when left out), the highest credible yearly rate rise (4) and the tolerance (5 percent). The signed report gives the system with its production per kW, each claim beside its recomputed figure as within, above_assumptions, rests_on_unconfirmed_incentive or unread, the assumptions with confirmed incentives, the offset and the payback with every incentive counted, and counts them, and names an inflated proposal: production above a credible yield, first-year or lifetime savings above what its own assumptions give, a payback shorter than its cost and confirmed incentives give and an offset above production over usage; then a payback that holds only with unconfirmed incentives, an unconfirmed incentive, a rate rise above the bound, no degradation and promise wording, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A missing size, production, rate, price, usage, cost or claim leaves the proposal unverifiable. This recomputes one proposal from its own assumptions: several quotes for one job side by side are wever_quote-compare, one vendor quote is wever_vendor-quote-check and a claim against offered evidence is wever_claim-evidence-check. Verdict energy_solar_inflated, energy_solar_partial, energy_solar_unverifiable or energy_solar_sound. POST /api/energy-solar-quote-check. Reads the energy records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Energy reads an energy customer’s own records and recomputes what they claim: the rate plan billed against the plan quoted, a solar or PPA proposal’s production and savings against its stated assumptions, a supply contract against what was agreed, a charging session against the posted price, a carbon credit or certificate claim against its retirement records, a utility bill against its tariff and usage, a commercial demand charge against interval usage and the tariff’s demand rules, and an equipment efficiency or savings claim against its rating and baseline. Beside it, wever_invoice-check reads any invoice against the job it belongs to and wever_fee-evidence-check a fee schedule against a quote or invoice, while an energy check recomputes energy charges from rates, usage and the tariff’s own rules; wever_contract-diff-check compares two versions of one text, while the contract check reads the signed contract against what was agreed; and wever_environmental-evidence-check reads sustainability claims against offered evidence, while the carbon claim check reads the retirement records behind one claim. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-energy-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-energy/.

export_rate.description: Credit per exported kWh; the utility rate when left out.

ppa_escalation_percent.description: Yearly PPA price or lease payment rise.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

max_yield.description: Highest credible kWh per kW a year; 1900 when left out.

text.description: Sales wording, read for promises such as free solar.
